reviews.title: Amazing Learning Experience
reviews.text: This app is super easy to use, with a clean and straightforward interface that’s perfect a learner of any level. it goes beyond just teaching the language. you can also explore Ethiopian culture, history, and traditions. The interactive alphabet with audio pronunciation makes learning both fun and engaging. Lastly the stat tracker makes it easy to keep you on point with your progress through the app. Overall, it’s an amazing app for anyone looking to learn Amharic. 10/10!

reviews.title: Finally can learn Amharic

reviews.title: Horrible and sloppy copy of duolingo
reviews.text: This is a horrible and sloppy copy of duolingo. Audio is not even good quality and there is no professionalism. The way it was copied, it looks like a money grab. Design looks like it was all created with ai. The images all look ai. The worst part is they are charging for a sloppy app. 9.99? A month? Or $70+ a year? No way! At least be original and put some real effort into building an app. I don’t recommend this at all. Stop being lazy and create an original app that is made to help people instead of looking like a “money grab”

reviews.title: Reading and learning
reviews.text: People shouldn’t have to pay to learn the Amharic language. If I want to speak Amharic, let it be free so anyone can use it. Also, the reading (Fidel), it should not JUST be flash cards but just like the lessons. For example, lesson one, we will cover these letter families, etc. It’s a great resource I’m sure but there are also good recourses that are free and open to everyone. God bless you.
